title: An deiner Stelle
desc: Talking somebody out of a lamp
setting: The second floor of the Brockenhaus on a Saturday morning, and the first thing she has seen.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Die nehme ich. Die ist schön.
steps.en: I will take that one. It is nice.

options.es: An deiner Stelle würde ich noch warten.
options.en: In your place I would wait a bit.
options.feedback: Advice from beside her rather than in front of her. She can still say no to it.
True, and it decides for her. She will take it anyway and it will annoy her for three years.

options.es: Wenn sie dir gefällt, nimm sie.
options.en: If you like it, take it.
options.feedback: Kind, and she asked you along for a reason.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Warum nicht? Sie kostet nur fünfundvierzig.
steps.en: Why not? It only costs forty-five.

options.feedback: The real reason, and it is about the shop and not about her taste.

options.es: Die Fassung gibt es nicht mehr zu kaufen.
options.en: You cannot buy that fitting any more.
options.feedback: A fact she cannot know and would find out in a week. This is what she brought you for.

options.es: Fünfundvierzig ist viel für eine Lampe.
options.en: Forty-five is a lot for a lamp.
options.feedback: It is not, and it makes it about money when it is about the room.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Aber die Wohnung ist so leer.
steps.en: But the flat is so empty.

options.es: Ich weiss. Ich habe damals einen zu kleinen Tisch gekauft.
options.en: I know. Back then I bought a table that was too small.
options.feedback: Now the story helps, because it is the same mistake and she is standing in front of it.
It is the reason, and everybody who has stood in an empty flat knows it.

options.es: In zwei Wochen ist sie voll.
options.en: In two weeks it will be full.
options.feedback: Probably true and it does not touch what she just said.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Also gut. Dann schauen wir noch oben.
steps.en: All right then. Then we will look upstairs too.

options.es: Und wenn oben nichts ist, kommen wir zurück.
options.en: And if there is nothing upstairs, we will come back.
options.feedback: Leave her the way back. That is what makes it advice instead of a veto.

options.es: Gut. Die wäre sowieso falsch gewesen.
options.en: Good. That one would have been wrong anyway.
options.feedback: You have won. Saying so is the one thing that turns advice into being told.
Neutral to the point of being cold, after she has just taken your advice.
